## PHASE 8 — Smoke Tests

Generate `fapi-tests/smoke.sh` — runs automatically after pre-flight:

```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# FAPI Integration Smoke Tests — generated by fapi-integration skill v2.0.0
# Usage: ./fapi-tests/smoke.sh [gateway_url]

GATEWAY="${1:-http://localhost:3100}"
PASS=0; FAIL=0
declare -a ISSUES

check() {
  local name="$1" result="$2" expect="$3" fix="$4"
  if echo "$result" | grep -q "$expect"; then
    printf "  ✅  %-55s PASS\n" "$name"
    ((PASS++))
  else
    printf "  ❌  %-55s FAIL\n" "$name"
    echo "      Got:      ${result:0:100}"
    echo "      Expected: $expect"
    echo "      Fix:      $fix"
    ISSUES+=("$name → $fix")
    ((FAIL++))
  fi
}

echo ""
echo "╔══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗"
echo "║  FAPI 2.0 Integration Smoke Tests                       ║"
echo "╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝"
echo "  Gateway: $GATEWAY"
echo ""

echo "── 1. Gateway ───────────────────────────────────────────────"
R=$(curl -sf "$GATEWAY/health" 2>/dev/null || echo "CONNECT_FAILED")
check "Gateway health endpoint responds"          "$R" '"status":"ok"' \
  "Start gateway: cd fapi-gateway && npm start"

echo ""
echo "── 2. Authentication Enforcement ───────────────────────────"

R=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" "$GATEWAY/api/test" 2>/dev/null)
check "Unauthenticated request → 401"              "$R" "401" \
  "fapiEnforceMiddleware not registerd — check addHook in server.ts"

R=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer fake.token.here" \
  "$GATEWAY/api/test" 2>/dev/null)
check "Plain Bearer token → 401 (DPoP required)"  "$R" "401" \
  "isDPoP check failing — verify Authorization header parse in fapi-enforce.ts"

R=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" \
  -H "Authorization: DPoP fake.token.here" \
  "$GATEWAY/api/test" 2>/dev/null)
check "DPoP token without proof header → 401"      "$R" "401" \
  "Missing DPoP header check — verify dpopHeader guard in fapi-enforce.ts"

echo ""
echo "── 3. Header Injection Prevention ──────────────────────────"

R=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" "$GATEWAY/api/test" \
  -H "X-Fapi-Verified: true" \
  -H "X-Fapi-Subject: injected-user" 2>/dev/null)
check "Injected X-Fapi-* headers still → 401"     "$R" "401" \
  "Header stripping not working — check Nginx proxy_set_header + middleware delete"

echo ""
echo "── 4. PAR Validation ────────────────────────────────────────"

GOOD_CHALLENGE=$(echo -n "$(openssl rand -base64 32 | tr '+/' '-_' | tr -d '=')" \
  | openssl dgst -sha256 -binary | base64 | tr '+/' '-_' | tr -d '=')
GOOD_STATE=$(openssl rand -base64 32 | tr '+/' '-_' | tr -d '=')
GOOD_NONCE=$(openssl rand -base64 32 | tr '+/' '-_' | tr -d '=')

R=$(curl -s -X POST "$GATEWAY/par" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded" \
  -d "client_id=unknown-client&response_type=code&redirect_uri=https://app.test.com/cb&scope=openid&state=${GOOD_STATE}&nonce=${GOOD_NONCE}&code_challenge=${GOOD_CHALLENGE}&code_challenge_method=S256")
check "PAR with unknown client_id → error"         "$R" '"error"' \
  "ALLOWED_CLIENT_IDS not set — check .env"

R=$(curl -s -X POST "$GATEWAY/par" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded" \
  -d "client_id={{profile.sso.clientId}}&response_type=token&redirect_uri={{profile.sso.redirectUri}}&scope=openid&state=${GOOD_STATE}&nonce=${GOOD_NONCE}&code_challenge=${GOOD_CHALLENGE}&code_challenge_method=S256")
check "PAR with response_type=token → error"       "$R" '"error"' \
  "Implicit flow not blocked — check response_type guard in par-handler.ts"

R=$(curl -s -X POST "$GATEWAY/par" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded" \
  -d "client_id={{profile.sso.clientId}}&response_type=code&redirect_uri={{profile.sso.redirectUri}}&scope=openid&state=${GOOD_STATE}&nonce=${GOOD_NONCE}&code_challenge=${GOOD_CHALLENGE}&code_challenge_method=plain")
check "PAR with plain PKCE → error (S256 required)" "$R" '"error"' \
  "plain PKCE not rejected — check validateChallengeFormat"

R=$(curl -s -X POST "$GATEWAY/par" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded" \
  -d "client_id={{profile.sso.clientId}}&response_type=code&redirect_uri={{profile.sso.redirectUri}}&scope=openid&state=short&nonce=short&code_challenge=${GOOD_CHALLENGE}&code_challenge_method=S256")
check "PAR with weak state/nonce → error"           "$R" '"error"' \
  "State/nonce length not validated — check par-handler.ts"

echo ""
echo "── 5. Rate Limiting ─────────────────────────────────────────"
echo "   (sending 20 rapid requests...)"
for i in $(seq 1 20); do
  curl -s -o /dev/null -X POST "$GATEWAY/par" &
done
wait
R=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -X POST "$GATEWAY/par")
check "Rate limit activates after burst"            "$R" "429" \
  "Rate limiting not firing — check @fastify/rate-limit config in server.ts"

echo ""
echo "── 6. Spring AS specific ────────────────────────────────────"
# Only run if sso.type === spring-as
SSO_TYPE="{{profile.sso.type}}"
if [ "$SSO_TYPE" = "spring-as" ]; then
  R=$(curl -sf "{{profile.sso.discoveryUrl}}" 2>/dev/null | python3 -c \
    "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print('OK' if 'pushed_authorization_request_endpoint' in d else 'PAR_MISSING')" \
    2>/dev/null || echo "FETCH_FAILED")
  check "Spring AS discovery has PAR endpoint"      "$R" "OK" \
    "PAR not in discovery — add pushed_authorization_request_endpoint to Spring AS config (see F7)"
fi

echo ""
echo "╔══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗"
printf "║  Results: %d passed  /  %d failed%s║\n" \
  "$PASS" "$FAIL" "$(printf ' %.0s' $(seq 1 $((41 - ${#PASS} - ${#FAIL} - 18))))"
echo "╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝"

if [ ${#ISSUES[@]} -gt 0 ]; then
  echo ""
  echo "  Action items:"
  for i in "${ISSUES[@]}"; do
    echo "    ▸ $i"
  done
fi

echo ""
exit $FAIL
```
